resolution_revision: The initial 0.025/0.0125 s sweep with 0.1 s saved samples passed classification/period/amplitude refinement but missed the unchanged energy and independent-solver gates. The full sweep was repeated at 0.0125/0.00625 s with 0.05 s samples. The initial numerical failures are retained in the results audit; no scientific parameter or acceptance tolerance changed.
interpretation: Finite deterministic parameter sweep of the existing synthetic active Hug. One parameter at a time and 16 reproducible joint perturbations are sensitivity scenarios, not probabilities or measured uncertainty. Mass, geometry, controller delay, force RMS and model form remain fixed. Orbit periods are chosen simulation inputs, not astronomical periods. A finite-time nonrepeat is not a diagnosis of chaos. No physical measurements or additional SIMS participants.
